title: prefill+decode: chunked speculative prefill with stage overlap and kernel scheduler improvements
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: decode throughput and tail latency for real-world chat workloads are dominated by suboptimal prefill handling and kernel scheduling when prefill sequences are long or when requests exhibit bursty token patterns. This PR implements a combined approach: chunked prefill to split long prefill sequences into smaller prefill blocks, speculative prefill to speculatively compute KV updates for likely next-token prefixes, and stage overlap so prefill and decode stages can run concurrently when safe. Additionally we introduce heuristic improvements to the kernel scheduler to prioritize coalescing of compute for chunk boundaries and to prevent kernel thrashing. Key goals: (1) improve end-to-end throughput for long-prefill requests, (2) reduce p50/p95 decode latency for mixed workloads, and (3) maintain or improve cost/unit through better batching and KV cache reuse. Changes: - runtime/prefill: add chunked prefill execution path and a lightweight chunk boundary API for schedulers and KV manager to hook into. - runtime/prefill: speculative prefill controller that maintains speculative KV state per request and reconciles with canonical KV on misprediction. - runtime/scheduler: kernel_scheduler updates introduce chunk-aware prioritization, a new bandwidth heuristic to reduce small-kernel overhead, and backpressure signals to the batcher. - runtime/kv: KV cache changed to support speculative entries with eventual reconciliation and a TTL policy tuned for chunked prefill. - runtime/batching: continuous batcher updated to prefer chunk coalescing and to expose metrics for chunk size and speculative hit/miss rates. - tests/bench: added regression and microbench suites exercising chunked prefill, speculative prefill misprediction scenarios, and stage-overlap correctness. Benchmarks (internal cluster, A100x8, mixed chat workload with 512-token prefill / 64-token decode batches): - End-to-end tokens/sec: +28% vs main on mixed workload with chunk size=128 and speculative enabled. - p95 latency: -18% for tail requests; p50 latency: -10%. - Token cost: ~12% reduction due to better KV reuse and coalesced kernels. - Speculative hit rate: 76% on labeled production prompt traces; when mispredicted cost overhead is ~6% extra work for those requests. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated behind prefill_chunking and speculative_prefill flags; default off for Dedicated until validated by canary. Canary on hosted with 10% traffic and kernel_scheduler heuristic set to conservative mode. Safety and correctness: reconciliation path ensures deterministic outputs identical to non-speculative path when speculative predictions are rolled back; added end-to-end correctness tests and fuzzing on KV reconciliation. Observability: new metrics pref.prefill_chunk_size, pref.speculative_hit_rate, sched.chunk_coalesced_kernels, kv.speculative_entries, and alerts added for speculative_misprediction_rate>20%. Migration notes: no customer-visible API changes; internal rollout only. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for chunking controller and KV reconciliation - [x] Integration tests for stage overlap - [x] Benchmarks added and documented - [x] Feature flags and safe defaults - [x] Docs updated (perf notes)

review_comments: Liam Chen: Can you summarize worst-case extra work for mispredicted speculative entries and how rollback behaves under cancellation?

Ava Martinez (author): Worst-case we do one extra chunk worth of work (~chunk_size*kernel_cost). Reconciliation is idempotent; cancelled requests trigger reconciliation cleanup and speculative entries are GC'd. Added tests and a race fix (3a8f6b2).
Priya Nair: The kernel scheduler heuristic looks promising but please add tunable thresholds and a conservative default. Also add metrics to observe kernel thrashing.
Ava Martinez: Added threshold config + sched.chunk_coalesced_kernels metric; conservative defaults set in infra/feature_flags/prefill_flags.yaml.
Diego Alvarez: CI fuzz found a corner race with KV reconciliation and cancellation; see commit 3a8f6b2 which fixes it. Verified locally with stress harness.
Liam Chen: Verified benchmark results and review approved after CI rerun.
